entries.title: Alphabet Typing Speed
entries.ai_quote: Alphabet Typing Speed: remade as a wood-type race from A to Z, with a ghost of your best, a rhythm strip and a fair Daily board

gameplay.input: Inside iframe clicked the game body, pressed A, then typed B through Z.
gameplay.response: Game finished the alphabet run in 0.79 seconds and displayed “MASTER PRINTER” and “New best.”

entries.title: Peel & Seek
entries.ai_quote: add a new game created by claude using a silly prompt

gameplay.input: In the iframe, clicked the soccer-ball sticker matching the displayed ⚽ target.
gameplay.response: The target changed from ⚽ to 🦅, the sticker field rerolled, and the matched soccer-ball sticker appeared as collected.

entries.title: Death by AI
entries.ai_quote: Death by AI: remake as a Grand Guignol theatre with a tested core

gameplay.input: Raised the curtain with an outer-page click, selected Crowbar, filled the plan textarea with “Jam the crowbar into the rope and lever it away from my position.” and clicked Risk it.
gameplay.response: The narrator showed SURVIVED, quoted the submitted plan, and returned “You take one polite step to the left. The piano lands with a chord composers will study for years. You are unplayed.” The iframe displayed the resolved outcome after its countdown.

entries.title: Under the Lamp
entries.ai_quote: add mystery ai, a game completely envisioned and developed by Claude 3.7

gameplay.input: Took the case, asked Rosalind “Where were you at 9:50?” and clicked Ask.
gameplay.response: Rosalind returned the same substantive alibi: “The drawing room! With Jasper, playing piquet, from nine — until everyone started shouting.”

entries.title: Tumbler — Guess the Number
entries.ai_quote: Tumbler: Guess the Number remade as a safecracking heist

gameplay.input: Started RANDOM HEIST, entered valid one-digit guess 5 in the combination input, and clicked TRY.
gameplay.response: The game entered the active SAFE I 0–9 screen and displayed “0 OPENED” plus lower/higher nudge controls; canvas signature changed from ebe774eb5c1a641d to 4cad4aad4d4edd1e. Guess-specific higher/lower feedback was not separately isolated.

entries.caveat: Guess-specific higher/lower feedback not separately isolated.

entries.title: Pong
entries.ai_quote: Pong: remade as top-down table tennis against a club ladder

gameplay.input: Clicked PLAY PIP, clicked the table canvas, pressed ArrowUp, and moved the paddle pointer.
gameplay.response: The game entered play, the pause control became active, and canvas signature changed b8a9e0f5ab3e58da → e2f73b5fe1a037d1.

entries.title: Simon Says
entries.ai_quote: Simon Says: remake as a lacquered four-lens device with a tested core

gameplay.input: Selected Free play, clicked central Start hub, then clicked first SVG color pad after observing a one-step sequence.
gameplay.response: The game advanced to “YOUR TURN / Your turn”; hub aria label changed from “Start a game” to “YOUR TURN”.

entries.title: Boogie Woogie
entries.ai_quote: Boogie Woogie: Blockdrop rebuilt as a falling-block game after Mondrian

gameplay.input: Clicked PLAY Marathon, clicked playfield, pressed ArrowLeft and Space.
gameplay.response: Gameplay HUD appeared with HOLD, SCORE 34, LEVEL 1 and PAUSE; canvas signature changed e8c6919fa095f49a → 5fd66b29a8ac16d5.

entries.title: Margins (Tic-Tac-Toe)
entries.ai_quote: Remake Tic-Tac-Toe as Margins: ink on a notebook page, a match to three

gameplay.input: Selected Play the computer and placed a mark in the first grid cell.
gameplay.response: The page moved to the match UI: “You are X and go first” and “Thinking…” appeared, along with the in-game play-again/back controls.

entries.title: Departures — a time travel agency
entries.ai_quote: Departures: work in progress on the Time Travel Agency remake

gameplay.input: Clicked the visible DISPATCH +1 control on the 1969 Apollo 11 service.
gameplay.response: The service changed to “BACK IN 0.8s +1”; COLLECT became available. This was a visible state transition; canvas is not used.
